implementation_notes: The Swift optimiser is strong, so measure with XCTest's `measure {}` blocks or Instruments before changing anything. Watch retain counts and exclusivity; check for bridging to Objective-C in a supposedly pure-Swift hot path.
idiom_name: XCTest measure blocks + Instruments Time Profiler
pitfalls: Bridging and retain/release traffic invisible in the source
Optimising a function the compiler had already inlined
